recipes.title: Chicken and Tomato Spaghetti Bake
steps:
Prep ingredients
Dice 1 yellow onion, 1 red bell pepper, 2 garlic cloves, and cut 450 g chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces. Shred 100 g cheddar cheese.

Boil spaghetti
Bring a large pot of water to a boil, add 250 g spaghetti, and cook for 8–10 minutes until al dente before draining.

Cook chicken and vegetables
Place a skillet over medium heat, add the chicken thighs, diced yellow onion, red bell pepper, and garlic, cooking for 8–10 minutes while stirring until vegetables are tender and chicken reaches 165°F in the thickest part on a food thermometer.

Simmer tomato sauce
Stir 1 can canned diced tomatoes and 100 g spinach into the skillet, simmering for 3–5 minutes until the spinach is wilted and sauce is hot.

Bake and serve
Combine the drained spaghetti and skillet sauce in a baking dish, top with 100 g shredded cheddar cheese, and bake at 375°F for 10 minutes until melted and bubbly.

recipes.title: Savory Chicken and Egg Rice Bowl
steps:
Cook jasmine rice
In a pot, bring 300 g jasmine rice and water to a boil, cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 15 minutes until tender and water is absorbed.

Sauté chicken and vegetables
In a large skillet over medium-high heat, cook 450 g diced chicken thighs, 1 sliced yellow onion, 1 sliced red bell pepper, and 3 minced garlic cloves for 8–10 minutes until vegetables are translucent and chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F on a food thermometer.

Wilt spinach
Add 100 g spinach to the skillet and toss for 1–2 minutes until completely wilted and bright green.

Scramble eggs
Push chicken and vegetables to one side of skillet, crack 4 eggs into the open side, and scramble for 2–3 minutes until set.

Assemble bowls
Divide cooked jasmine rice among four bowls and top evenly with stir-fried chicken, vegetables, and scrambled eggs.

recipes.title: Cheddar Egg and Vegetable Frittata
steps:
Prep ingredients and oven
Preheat oven to 375°F, whisk 8 eggs in a large bowl, and shred 100 g cheddar cheese.

Sauté vegetables
In an oven-safe skillet over medium heat, sauté 1 chopped yellow onion, 1 chopped red bell pepper, and 2 minced garlic cloves for 5–7 minutes until tender and translucent.

Add tomatoes
Drain 1 can canned diced tomatoes, add to the skillet, and cook for 2–3 minutes until excess moisture evaporates.

Combine and set edges
Pour whisked eggs into skillet over vegetables, top with 100 g shredded cheddar cheese, and cook undisturbed on stovetop for 2 minutes until edges begin to set.

Bake frittata
Transfer skillet to preheated oven and bake for 10–12 minutes until eggs are completely set and cheese is golden.

steps:

Place a large skillet over medium-high heat and add 900 g chicken thighs skin-side down. Cook for 8–10 minutes until fat renders and skin is browned, then transfer chicken to a plate.

Sauté aromatics
Add 3 diced yellow onions and 8 minced garlic cloves to the skillet with the rendered chicken fat over medium heat. Stir for 5–7 minutes until onions are translucent and garlic is fragrant.

Sear the chicken

Steam the broccoli
Add the broccoli florets to the skillet with the chicken breast, cover with a tight-fitting lid, and steam over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes until bright green and crisp-tender.

Sear chicken
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat, add the diced chicken thighs, and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until browned and a food thermometer reads 165°F in the thickest part.

Boil spaghetti
Bring a pot of water to a boil, add 250 g spaghetti, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes until al dente before draining.

Sauté vegetables and sauce
In the skillet over medium heat, cook the yellow onions and red bell peppers for 5 minutes until soft, stir in the garlic for 1 minute until fragrant, then add 1 can canned diced tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes until thickened.

Combine and finish
Toss the drained spaghetti, cooked chicken, and spinach into the tomato sauce for 2 minutes until spinach is wilted, then top with shredded cheddar cheese, cover until melted, and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken and Egg Fried Jasmine Rice
steps:

Cook chicken
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat, add 450 g cut chicken thighs, and stir-fry for 6 to 8 minutes until cooked through and a food thermometer reaches 165°F in the thickest piece.

Scramble eggs
Beat 4 eggs, pour into the hot skillet over medium heat, and scramble for 1 to 2 minutes until soft curds form, then transfer to a dish.

Stir-fry vegetables
Add 1.5 diced yellow onions and 1.5 sliced red bell peppers to the skillet, cook for 4 to 5 minutes until translucent, then stir in 4 minced garlic cloves for 1 minute until fragrant.

Finish fried rice
Add the cooked jasmine rice, cooked chicken, scrambled eggs, and 100 g spinach to the skillet, tossing over high heat for 2 minutes until the spinach wilts and everything is hot.

recipes.title: Cheesy Tomato Scramble with Rice
steps:

Scramble eggs and cheese
Whisk 6 eggs and pour into the simmered tomatoes, gently stirring for 3 to 4 minutes until curds form, then fold in 100 g shredded cheddar cheese until melted.

Serve over rice
Divide the warm cooked jasmine rice among bowls and top evenly with the cheesy tomato egg scramble.

Step 4: Simmer and braise
Nestle the chicken thighs into the rice mixture. Cover tightly, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 20 minutes until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F on a food thermometer.

Step 5: Fold in spinach and serve
Remove from heat, fold in 100 g spinach until wilted from the residual steam, and divide evenly among three plates.

recipes.title: Rustic Chicken and Spinach Stew with Steamed Rice
steps:
Step 1: Steam the rice
In a small pot, combine 250 g jasmine rice with 375 ml water. Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 15 minutes until liquid is fully absorbed, then remove from heat to rest.

Step 2: Brown the diced chicken
Dice 450 g chicken thighs into bite-sized chunks. Place a heavy saucepan over medium-high heat, add the chicken, and cook for 5–6 minutes until browned on the exterior.

Step 3: Cook aromatics and tomatoes
Add 1 diced yellow onion and 2 minced garlic cloves to the pan, cooking for 3 minutes until softened. Stir in 1 can canned diced tomatoes and 1/2 cup water, bringing the mixture to a steady simmer.

Step 4: Simmer to safe temperature
Cover the pot and simmer gently over medium-low heat for 12–15 minutes until chicken is tender and reaches 165°F at the thickest pieces measured with a food thermometer.

Step 5: Wilt greens and plate
Stir in 100 g spinach and cook for 1–2 minutes until completely wilted. Fluff the reserved rice and ladle the chicken stew generously over top.

recipes.title: Savory Garlic and Onion Jasmine Rice Porridge
steps:
Step 1: Sauté aromatics
Finely dice 1 yellow onion and mince 4 cloves garlic. In a medium soup pot, heat a tablespoon of water or cook directly over medium-low heat with the diced onion and garlic for 4–5 minutes until translucent and aromatic.

Step 2: Add rice and simmer
Stir in 150 g jasmine rice and 1 liter of water. Bring to a rolling boil over high heat.

Step 3: Simmer to thicken
Reduce heat to low, cover partially, and simmer for 25–30 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking, until the grains break down into a thick, velvety porridge.

Step 4: Portion and serve
Ladle the hot aromatic rice porridge into two deep bowls and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Braised Chicken and Bell Pepper Rice
steps:
Step 1: Brown the chicken
Heat a wide skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add 450 g chicken thighs cut into bite-sized pieces and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden brown on all sides.

Step 2: Sauté aromatics
Add 1 chopped yellow onion, 1 chopped red bell pepper, and 2 minced garlic cloves directly into the rendered chicken fat. Sauté over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes until the vegetables soften and the onion turns translucent.

Step 3: Simmer with rice
Rinse 250 g jasmine rice and stir into the skillet along with 500 ml water. Bring to a boil, then cover with a tight-fitting lid, turn the heat to low, and cook for 18 minutes without opening the lid.

Step 4: Check doneness and rest
Remove the lid and verify that the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F on a food thermometer and the rice is tender. Fluff the rice with a fork and let rest for 3 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Tomato Basil-Style Chicken Spaghetti
steps:
Step 1: Boil the spaghetti
Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Add 250 g spaghetti and cook for 9 to 10 minutes until al dente, reserving 1/2 cup of cooking water before draining.

Step 2: Cook the chicken
In a deep pan over medium heat, sear 450 g cubed chicken thighs for 6 to 8 minutes until lightly browned on the edges.

Step 3: Build the tomato sauce
Add 1 chopped yellow onion and 2 minced garlic cloves, stirring for 3 minutes until softened. Pour in 1 can canned diced tomatoes, reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer for 12 to 15 minutes until the chicken reaches 165°F at the thickest pieces using a food thermometer and the sauce has reduced.

Step 4: Combine and serve
Add the drained spaghetti to the sauce, splashing in reserved water as needed, and toss over low heat for 1 minute until evenly coated.

recipes.title: Spinach, Cheddar, and Bell Pepper Frittata
steps:
Step 1: Prep and whisk
Preheat the oven broiler on high. In a mixing bowl, vigorously whisk 6 eggs until smooth and evenly blended.

Step 2: Sauté the vegetables
Place an oven-safe skillet over medium heat. Add 1 finely diced red bell pepper and 1 minced garlic clove, sautéing for 4 minutes until tender, then add 100 g spinach and stir for 1 to 2 minutes until wilted.

Step 3: Cook the frittata base
Pour the beaten eggs evenly over the vegetables in the skillet, gently folding so the ingredients are distributed. Cook on low-medium heat for 5 to 6 minutes until the edges are completely set.

Step 4: Broil with cheddar
Scatter 100 g shredded cheddar cheese over the top and transfer the skillet under the oven broiler for 2 to 3 minutes until the eggs are firm, puffed, and the cheese is melted and bubbling.

recipes.title: Vegetable and Egg Fried Rice
steps:
Step 1: Cook the rice
In a pot, combine 250 g jasmine rice with 400 ml water. Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat to low, and cook for 12 to 14 minutes until tender, then spread the cooked rice onto a wide plate to cool and dry slightly.

Step 2: Scramble the eggs
Heat a wok or large frying pan over medium-high heat. Crack in 4 beaten eggs and stir rapidly for 1 to 2 minutes until just cooked into soft curds, then remove and set aside.

Step 3: Stir-fry the vegetables
In the same hot pan, add 1 chopped yellow onion and 1 diced red bell pepper, stir-frying for 3 to 4 minutes until crisp-tender. Add 2 minced garlic cloves and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.

Step 4: Combine and finish
Add the cooled cooked rice and scrambled eggs back into the pan, pressing and stirring continuously over high heat for 3 to 4 minutes until everything is steaming hot and evenly incorporated.

recipes.title: Cheesy Tomato and Spinach Baked Pasta
steps:
Step 1: Boil the pasta
Preheat the oven to 375°F. Bring a pot of water to a boil, add 250 g spaghetti broken into halves, and boil for 8 minutes until slightly underdone; drain well.

Step 2: Simmer tomato and spinach sauce
In a saucepot over medium heat, warm 1 minced garlic clove and 1 can canned diced tomatoes for 5 minutes until hot. Stir in 100 g spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted.

Step 3: Assemble the bake
Toss the drained spaghetti with the tomato-spinach sauce, transfer the mixture to an oven-safe baking dish, and spread 100 g shredded cheddar cheese evenly across the top.

Step 4: Bake until bubbly
Bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 18 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbling at the edges, then let stand for 5 minutes before portioning.

steps:

Add 150 grams of chopped broccoli florets to the steamer basket during the final 4 minutes of cooking and steam until bright green and fork-tender.

Assemble and serve
Fluff the cooked rice with a fork, divide between two bowls, and top evenly with the steamed chicken and broccoli.

recipes.title: Simmered Chicken and Broccoli Rice Congee
steps:

In a deep saucepan, combine 150 grams of jasmine rice with 1 liter of water, bring to a boil over high heat, then lower to medium-low and simmer uncovered for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally until thick and creamy.

Poach the chicken breast
Add 250 grams of thinly sliced chicken breast into the gently simmering porridge, stirring to separate the pieces, and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until completely opaque and a food thermometer confirms the internal temperature reaches 165°F.

Incorporate the broccoli
Stir 150 grams of finely chopped broccoli into the congee and simmer for 4 minutes until the broccoli is soft and tender.

Ladle and serve
Remove the pot from the heat and ladle the hot rice porridge and chicken mixture into two deep bowls.

recipes.title: One-Pot Braised Chicken with Rice and Broccoli
steps:
Brown the chicken breast
Heat a wide saucepan or skillet over medium heat, add 250 grams of diced chicken breast and 2 tablespoons of water, and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, turning occasionally until the surface turns opaque.

Simmer the rice and chicken
Pour 200 grams of jasmine rice and 360 ml of water into the skillet with the chicken, bring to a rapid simmer, cover with a tight-fitting lid, and reduce the heat to low for 10 minutes.

Add the broccoli to steam
Quickly uncover the skillet, spread 150 grams of bite-sized broccoli florets across the top of the rice, replace the lid, and continue cooking on low for 5 minutes until the rice is tender, broccoli is bright green, and the chicken registers 165°F on a food thermometer.

Rest and serve
Remove from the heat, let rest covered for 5 minutes, then gently fold the mixture together and divide between two plates.

recipes.title: One-Skillet Garlic Chicken and Rice Pilaf

recipes.title: Garlic Sautéed Chicken Thighs with Wilted Spinach and Rice

Remove cooked chicken to a plate to rest. Toss 200 g spinach into the pan with the remaining garlic pan drippings and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until fully wilted.

recipes.title: Simple Tomato Spinach Rice Bowl
steps:

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Chicken Fried Rice

Stir the cooked rice, cooked chicken, scrambled eggs, and 100 g spinach into the skillet. Cook over high heat for 3 minutes, tossing continuously, until the spinach is wilted and the fried rice is piping hot.

recipes.title: Cheesy Baked Chicken Spaghetti Casserole

Dice 600 g chicken thighs, 1 yellow onion, and 1 red bell pepper. Heat a skillet over medium-high heat, add chicken and vegetables, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes until chicken reaches 165°F on a food thermometer and vegetables are soft.

Shred 200 g cheddar cheese. In a large bowl, combine the drained spaghetti, cooked chicken and vegetable mixture, 1 can canned diced tomatoes, and half of the shredded cheese.

Bake the casserole
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top evenly with the remaining shredded cheddar cheese. Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbling.

recipes.title: Savory Spinach and Pepper Frittata

Nestle the browned chicken thighs back into the rice mixture. Cover, lower heat to medium-low, and cook for 20–25 minutes until the rice is tender.

Step 5: Food safety check
Check the thickest part of the chicken thighs with a food thermometer to ensure it reaches at least 165°F.

Step 6: Wilt spinach and serve
Remove from heat, fold in 100 g spinach until wilted, let stand covered for 5 minutes, and serve evenly into 4 portions.

recipes.title: Garlic Tomato Stewed Chicken over Jasmine Rice
steps:
Step 1: Steaming the rice
Combine 400 g jasmine rice and 600 ml water in a pot over high heat, bring to a boil, cover, reduce to low, and steam for 15 minutes until tender; remove from heat.

Step 2: Brown the chicken
Heat a wide saucepan over medium-high heat, add 900 g chicken thighs, and cook for 5–7 minutes on each side until golden brown; remove and set aside on a plate.

Step 3: Build stew base
Slice 2 yellow onions and thinly slice 4 garlic cloves, then add them to the pan fat over medium heat and stir for 4–6 minutes until translucent.

Step 4: Braise the stew
Pour in 1 can canned diced tomatoes and 200 ml water, then return the chicken to the pan. Cover and simmer gently for 20 minutes until the sauce reduces and thickens.

Step 5: Verify temp and add greens
Insert a food thermometer into the thickest part of the chicken to ensure it reaches 165°F. Stir in 100 g spinach during the last 2 minutes until wilted.

Step 6: Plate dish
Divide the warm steamed jasmine rice among 4 plates and top each portion with the stewed chicken and tomato-garlic sauce.
